title: Zorker OpenLink — Keep the Next Step in View
adaptation: Keeps the supplied 71-second, 11-act narrative and motion grammar. The ChatGPT data-analysis case becomes an illustrative OpenLink code-project story: repair a mobile purchase flow, understand why it failed, show the result, then leave a review-ready project state.
narrative: A shopper chooses a size and loses the next step. OpenLink traces the break, explains the cause, keeps the action beside the choice, and makes the changed project ready to review.

visualRules.canvas: Pure-white typography acts; airy full-bleed pastel gradient mesh behind product UI; a single dark product reveal.
visualRules.camera: One continuous constant-speed lateral move in the opening; locked UI stages; exactly one lateral wipe into the product result; hard cuts between all other acts.
visualRules.focus: One reading target per beat. No blur, vignette, grain, stock footage, 3D, or third-party product branding.
visualRules.text: Hero lines stay concise and exceed 24px at 1080p. Typography acts preserve broad white space. User prompt is the only typewriter passage.
visualRules.theme: The same mobile page and content appear in three palettes. The only cross-dissolves are the two matched theme changes.
visualRules.truthfulness: OpenLink interface components are source-derived. The Dash XV product, code changes, assistant events, and version record are deterministic illustrative fixtures, not a live provider or repository run.

audio.musicDescription: Original restrained electronic keynote score: a warm pulse, soft synth chords, low bass, short transition risers, a gentle closing downbeat, and a brief logo sting.

shots.title: 00 · Everyone
shots.purpose: Widen the audience before introducing Zorker OpenLink.
copy: Everyone can move an idea forward.
shots.camera: One continuous leftward track. Each word passes through the same center point; the last two states resolve into a sliding segmented pill.

shots.title: 01 · Thesis
shots.purpose: State the promise before proving it.
shots.copy: Every new product begins with a question.
shots.camera: Hard cut to a locked, centered white field.

shots.title: 02 · The ask
shots.purpose: A recognizable product problem arrives as a plain-language brief.
shots.copy: On Dash XV mobile, shoppers choose a size, then lose the buy button. Keep the next step in view.
shots.camera: A source-derived OpenLink composer rises on a soft periwinkle mesh. Type only this prompt at roughly 40ms per character, then one cursor click.

shots.title: 03 · The work
shots.purpose: Show a coherent investigation that follows the purchase path instead of a generic feature list.
copy: Keep the action with the choice.
shots.camera: Native OpenLink timeline. Reveal four related rows in sequence, then hold the completed chain for one second.

shots.title: 04 · The answer
shots.purpose: Name the cause, then make the missing relationship visible.
shots.copy: The choice worked. The buy action fell below the mobile viewport.
shots.camera: Hard cut to two concise lines and a small viewport diagram showing the action slipping below the fold.

shots.title: 05 · Why
shots.purpose: Explain the product insight rather than merely listing edits.
copy: The choice and the next step had lost context.
shots.camera: Word-by-word typography on white. Exactly one elastic 'why' stretch, held for 1.2 seconds, then one insight card rises with the second and final slow push-in.

shots.title: 06 · Action
shots.purpose: Turn the explanation into a focused, reviewable change.
copy: Keep the next step in view.
Pin the buy action to the selected size.
shots.camera: Hard cut to a periwinkle mesh. The native OpenLink change card assembles from source file to diff; one cursor click opens the diff.

shots.title: 07 · The result
shots.purpose: Let the repaired mobile product page become the hero.
shots.camera: The film's sole lateral wipe: large type exits left as the completed mobile page enters from the right. The page settles on a single dark campaign field.

shots.title: 08 · Make it yours
shots.purpose: Show that one structure can take on different brand voices.
shots.camera: The same mobile page, copy, sizes, and sticky action in three palettes. Two matched 1.5-second cross-dissolves; gentle parallax only.

shots.title: 09 · Review-ready
shots.purpose: Close the loop at the native project and version state without inventing external publishing or sharing.
copy: The change is in the project.
Preview it. Inspect the diff. Review the version.
shots.camera: Hard cut to the source-derived OpenLink workspace with the illustrative Dash XV preview, conversation, change card, and version menu.

shots.title: 10 · Closer
shots.purpose: Return to the promise and resolve to the Zorker OpenLink mark.
copy: Now anyone can turn a question into a working product.
shots.camera: White field; 2.5-second text hold; orange dot bloom to the lockup; logo hold; final four master frames black and silent.

illustrativeFixtureLimits: Dash XV, its product artwork, size selector, purchase button, price, viewport diagnosis, code diff, assistant activity, and review version are fictional deterministic demo data.
The film does not claim live model execution, analytics, conversion results, external publishing, or external sharing.
The depicted OpenLink product chrome is source-derived; decorative art and Dash XV page content are original film assets.
